metadata.title: The Parasites
metadata.description: Varroa mites are detected in the brood comb, threatening a generation of new bees.

metadata.title: The First Spring
metadata.description: The colony stirs after a long winter as the queen begins laying her first eggs of the season.

metadata.title: Legacy
metadata.description: The original queen, now in her third year, lays her final clutch of eggs.

metadata.title: A New Queen
metadata.description: A second queen hatches and the hive must decide whether to split or fight.

metadata.title: New Territories
metadata.description: Spring scouts push further than ever before, mapping flower-rich farmland a kilometre away.

metadata.title: Collapse
metadata.description: The hive population plummets as the mite infestation takes hold.

metadata.title: Rival Colonies
metadata.description: A neighbouring colony probes the hive's defences, triggering an intense guard response.

metadata.title: The Cold Spring
metadata.description: Unseasonably low temperatures delay the bloom and leave foragers idle for weeks.

metadata.title: First Swarm
metadata.description: A scout bee discovers a rich meadow and the hive mobilises its foragers for the first time.

metadata.title: The Final Queen
metadata.description: Daughter queens emerge and the colony must choose its next matriarch.

metadata.title: Population Boom
metadata.description: New leadership sparks an explosion in worker numbers just as summer reaches its height.

metadata.title: The Drought
metadata.description: A dry summer dries up key nectar sources and foragers must range far beyond their usual territory.

metadata.title: Building the Comb
metadata.description: Workers race to construct new honeycomb before the summer bloom peaks.

metadata.title: Rebirth
metadata.description: A surviving nucleus of bees rallies around a healthy queen to rebuild the colony.

metadata.title: Adaptation
metadata.description: Workers modify their foraging schedule to target evening-blooming flowers during the cool spell.

metadata.title: The Mite War
metadata.description: Workers use hygienic behaviour to uncap and remove infected larvae in a desperate counter-offensive.

metadata.title: The Queen's Command
metadata.description: Pheromone signals ripple through the hive as the queen asserts dominance over a restless workforce.

metadata.title: Pesticide Threat
metadata.description: Several foragers return disoriented after visiting a treated field, alarming the colony.

metadata.title: Cross-Pollination
metadata.description: The colony's efforts trigger a bumper crop in a nearby apple orchard.

metadata.title: The Last Summer
metadata.description: The colony harvests a record honey surplus, unknowingly preparing for the hardest winter yet.

metadata.title: Foraging Grounds
metadata.description: Two scout groups compete to map the most productive flower patches within a kilometre of the hive.

metadata.title: Distant Fields
metadata.description: Scouts discover a wildflower meadow three kilometres away, the furthest foraging range ever recorded.

metadata.title: Chemical Warfare
metadata.description: A beekeeper intervenes with treatment while the colony adapts its own defences.

metadata.title: The Beekeeper
metadata.description: A new keeper takes over the apiary, and the colony must adjust to different inspection rhythms.

metadata.title: The Migration
metadata.description: Half the colony swarms and searches for a new home inside a hollow oak.

metadata.title: The First Harvest
metadata.description: Honey is capped for the first time this year, but a rainstorm threatens to wash out the foragers.

metadata.title: Generation Next
metadata.description: A new cohort of drones takes flight to carry the colony's genes into neighbouring hives.

metadata.title: Old Enemies
metadata.description: Hornets mount a sustained raid on the hive entrance, met by a determined heat-ball defence.

metadata.title: Hive Mind
metadata.description: Scientists observe the colony's collective decision-making as workers choose between three potential nest sites.

metadata.title: The Swarm Returns
metadata.description: Former members of the original swarm rejoin the recovering colony, boosting numbers dramatically.

metadata.title: Resilience
metadata.description: After months of challenge, the colony closes the season at peak health and maximum population.

metadata.title: Honey Season
metadata.description: The colony stores record amounts of honey ahead of an unusually harsh winter forecast.

metadata.title: Survivors
metadata.description: Against the odds, the colony enters winter stronger than at any point since the crisis began.

metadata.title: Winter's Edge
metadata.description: The colony clusters tightly as the first frost arrives, rationing their precious honey reserves.

metadata.title: Full Circle
metadata.description: As autumn closes in, the cycle of seasons is complete and a new generation prepares to begin again.
